queries.sql: SELECT expense_type,count(*) AS n_rows,count(distinct utility_id_ferc1) AS entities,sum(dollar_value) AS dollars FROM SOURCE WHERE report_year=2025 AND expense_type IN ('transmission_expenses','transmission_operation_expense','transmission_maintenance_expense_electric','transmission_of_electricity_by_others') GROUP BY 1
queries.meaning: Subtotals overlap. Transmission-by-others is purchased service, not own-network operating cost. These are not complete capital-inclusive revenue requirements.

queries.sql: SELECT plant_status,count(distinct utility_id_ferc1) AS entities,sum(ending_balance) AS gross_plant_dollars,sum(additions) AS additions_dollars FROM SOURCE WHERE report_year=2025 AND ferc_account_label='transmission_plant' AND utility_type='electric' GROUP BY 1
queries.meaning: Book gross plant/additions, not allowed rate base, annual revenue requirement, or data-center-attributable net investment.

queries.sql: SELECT plant_status,count(distinct utility_id_ferc1) AS entities,sum(ending_balance) AS accumulated_depreciation_dollars FROM SOURCE WHERE report_year=2025 AND plant_function='transmission' AND utility_type='electric' AND depreciation_type='accumulated_depreciation' GROUP BY 1
queries.meaning: Accumulated depreciation stock, not annual depreciation expense; total and statuses overlap.

queries.sql: SELECT ferc_account_label,count(distinct utility_id_ferc1) AS entities,sum(dollar_value) AS annual_dollars FROM SOURCE WHERE report_year=2025 AND plant_function='transmission' GROUP BY 1
queries.meaning: Annual functional depreciation exists. Reported total and component sums do not exactly reconcile in the snapshot; do not add totals to components.

queries.sql: SELECT revenue_requirement_category,in_revenue_requirement,plant_function,count(distinct utility_id_ferc1) AS entities,sum(dollar_value) AS signed_dollars FROM SOURCE WHERE report_year=2025 AND (plant_function='transmission' OR revenue_requirement_category ILIKE '%return%' OR revenue_requirement_category ILIKE '%tax%') GROUP BY 1,2,3
queries.meaning: Useful reconciled accounting categories, but flags do not establish an authorized transmission RR. Tax items are not functionally assigned; signs reflect income-statement convention.

queries.sql: SELECT revenue_type,count(distinct utility_id_ferc1) AS entities,sum(dollar_value) AS dollars FROM SOURCE WHERE report_year=2025 AND revenue_type LIKE '%transmission%' GROUP BY 1
queries.meaning: Transmission-of-others and regional-service receipts do not encompass transmission recovered through bundled retail rates and may include interutility transactions.

queries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n_rows,count(distinct utility_id_eia) AS utilities,count(summer_peak_demand_mw) AS reported_summer_peak_rows,count(winter_peak_demand_mw) AS reported_winter_peak_rows,sum(summer_peak_demand_mw) AS raw_summer_peak_sum_mw,sum(winter_peak_demand_mw) AS raw_winter_peak_sum_mw FROM SOURCE WHERE year(report_date)=2025
queries.meaning: Utility noncoincident peaks include full/partial wholesale requirements customers and losses. Raw sum overlaps utility service scopes; not national tariff billing demand.

queries.sql: SELECT revenue_class,count(revenue) AS nonnull_rows,count(distinct CASE WHEN revenue>0 THEN utility_id_eia END) AS positive_utilities,sum(revenue) AS dollars FROM SOURCE WHERE year(report_date)=2025 GROUP BY 1
queries.meaning: Transmission revenue class is not all transmission revenue embedded in bundled retail or delivery charges; no matching NITS denominator is supplied.

findings.important_exception: Schedule326 has coincident/noncoincident/billing demand fields, but for purchased power contracts, not national network transmission rate-zone billing determinants.
why_RR_incomplete: Authorized functional return and tariff rate base, ADIT/working-capital adjustments, allocated taxes/general costs, revenue credits and tariff true-ups are not assembled into NITS-zone ARR by this dataset.
Form1 accounting coverage is not all US transmission providers.
Detailed income statement in_revenue_requirement categories are accounting classifications, not complete filed transmission formula rates.
why_capex_per_MW_unidentified: Book additions have no reliable project-level causal match to data-center MW.
Additions include replacement, reliability and other loads.
Dedicated facilities, network upgrades, customer contributions and tariff baseline overlap require project/tariff records.
findings.conclusion: PUDL materially strengthens empirical accounting checks but does not replace the explicitly labeled national cost-to-peak NITS-equivalent proxy in this bounded review.
findings.pool_comment: Using829GW reproduces the peak denominator of the existing EIA/GridStrategies proxy. It is a2025 national planning-peak benchmark, not measured2026 incumbent tariff billing demand. National homogeneous pooling and future DC geographic weighting remain assumptions.
